    some disj a : Photo |

    some disj h: Worker |

        begin = w
        end = w
        Workstation <: workers = w->h

        Worker = h

        Robot = none

run NegativeScenario3 {
    some disj p1, p2, s : Person |
    some c : Course |
    some disj pr1, pr2 : Project |
    some disj g1, g2 : Grade {
        Person = p1 + p2 + s
        Professor = p1 + p2
        Student = p2 + s
        Course = c

        Grade = g1 + g2
